verses.en: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!
verses.pt: Oh! quão bom e quão suave é que os irmãos vivam em união!
verses.en_web: See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
verses.en_bbe: <A Song of the going up. Of David.> See how good and how pleasing it is for brothers to be living together in harmony!

verses.en: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron’s beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;
verses.pt: É como o óleo precioso sobre a cabeça, que desceu sobre a barba, a barba de Arão, que desceu sobre a gola das suas vestes;
verses.en_web: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard; that came down on the edge of his robes;
verses.en_bbe: It is like oil of great price on the head, flowing down over the face, even Aaron's face: coming down to the edge of his robe;

verses.en: As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the LORD commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.
verses.pt: como o orvalho de Hermom, que desce sobre os montes de Sião; porque ali o Senhor ordenou a bênção, a vida para sempre.
verses.en_web: like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion: for there Yahweh gives the blessing, even life forever more.
verses.en_bbe: Like the dew of Hermon, which comes down on the mountains of Zion: for there the Lord gave orders for the blessing, even life for ever.
